label: CONNECTION

cover.headline: Saying no to *the December overload*
cover.sub: 5 ways to keep the season from swallowing you.

points.heading: Choose your top three
points.body: Pick the three events that matter most, together.
points.panel: “Which plans would we actually miss if we skipped them?”

points.heading: Say no kindly, once
points.body: You don’t need a long explanation.
points.panel: “We can’t make it this year, but thank you for inviting us.”

points.heading: Leave white space
points.body: Empty evenings are what make the busy ones bearable.
points.panel: Block two quiet nights in the calendar now.

points.heading: Share the to-do list
points.body: Write it down and split it, so one person isn’t carrying it all.

points.heading: Keep one thing just for you two
points.body: A tradition that’s yours, not anyone else’s.
points.panel: “What’s one thing you’d love us to do together this month?”

close.save: Save this before your calendar fills up.

caption:
December can turn a marriage into a logistics team: parties, gifts, travel, and endless plans.

You don’t have to do it all. Choosing together what matters, and saying no to the rest, protects your energy and your closeness. Here are five ways to do it, starting this weekend.

Save this before your calendar fills up, and follow @spotseason for more.
